# 10-K Analyzer

> Free dashboards and infographics of US public companies' financial results, built only from their SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, 40-F, 8-K earnings releases, S-1/F-1 for IPOs). Figures are as filed, never estimated. 2,924 companies; updated through the day on business days.

## How to use it
- Company page (plain text, key figures, sources): https://alexandermou.github.io/10k-analyzer/c/<TICKER>.html, e.g. https://alexandermou.github.io/10k-analyzer/c/NVDA.html
- Interactive dashboard, latest annual report: https://alexandermou.github.io/10k-analyzer/#<ticker>-10k (e.g. #nvda-10k); its infographic image: #<ticker>-10k-image
- A quarter: https://alexandermou.github.io/10k-analyzer/#<ticker>-q<N>-fy<YYYY> (e.g. #nvda-q3-fy2027); add -image for the infographic
- Each dashboard shows revenue, a revenue-to-profit flow (Sankey) chart, margins, cash flow, balance sheet, segments and quarterly trends, with the SEC filing it came from.

## Lists
- [All companies A–Z](https://alexandermou.github.io/10k-analyzer/c/index.html)
- [Latest filings and earnings releases](https://alexandermou.github.io/10k-analyzer/#latest)
- [Upcoming earnings dates (our forecast)](https://alexandermou.github.io/10k-analyzer/#upcoming)
- [IPOs: new listings and the SEC pipeline](https://alexandermou.github.io/10k-analyzer/#ipo)
- [FAQ](https://alexandermou.github.io/10k-analyzer/#faq)

## Data policy
All figures come from the companies' own filings on SEC EDGAR. When an earnings release is used before the 10-Q, the page says so. The IPO New tab also uses the Nasdaq and NYSE IPO calendars for listing dates and offer amounts.
